title: A new formulation of Discontinuous Galerkin method for interface capturing approaches
summary: In computational fluid dynamics, the numerical simulation of free-surface flows using interface capturing approaches (level set, pseudo-concentration) requires accurate resolution of a transport equation. In the present work, this equation is solved using a new formulation of the Lesaint--Raviart discontinuous Galerkin method, which is particularly suitable for problems without inflow boundaries.
